en.agentBusyInstall: An agent is currently working — wait for it to finish (or cancel it) before installing. Installing changes plugin files, so a working agent can fail mid-turn.
en.agentBusyUpdate: An agent is currently working — wait for it to finish (or cancel it) before updating. Updates replace plugin files in place, so a working agent can fail or mix versions mid-turn.
en.aiFixConservative: Be conservative: only fix the clear errors listed above (boot failures / duplicate entries / confirmed dependency mismatches). Treat warnings and informational entries (e.g. unconfirmed peer ranges) only when they relate to a clear error. Do not perform unnecessary upgrades or reordering; explain each change and wait for confirmation.
en.aiFixCopied: Fix prompt copied — paste it into a new conversation and send when ready
en.aiFixFail: Clipboard unavailable — copy the diagnostics below manually
en.aiFixHint: Hand the diagnostics to a new Agent session (copied to the clipboard; you decide whether to send)
en.aiFixIntro: Please help me fix the plugin issues of DeepSeek Harness (profile: {0}). Diagnostics found:
en.aiFixScope: You may reorder dsh.profile.bundles, disable/enable plugins, or adjust cordis.patch.yml. Note: official bundles are fixed; state your plan before changing anything.
en.autoBackup: Back up daily (when the market opens)
en.backupHint: Includes the plugin list and profile configuration, never node_modules. Restore reinstalls plugins from the list.
en.buildsSkipped: This plugin needs its build scripts to run; they are blocked by default for safety. Click below to allow them and reinstall:
en.busyWait: Another operation is already running — please wait for it to finish (one install/update/uninstall at a time)
en.compatRiskBanner: Compatibility risk detected — open Diagnostics before restarting, or roll this operation back.
en.confirmWarn: Plugins are third-party community code. Installing means you trust this source; build scripts are blocked by default.
en.credsWarning: Heads up: backups include profile configuration and files that may hold secrets (config.toml, .env, …). Local exports are unmodified, so only upload to a WebDAV target you trust.
en.deprecatedWarn: This plugin is marked as deprecated by the catalog; new users are advised against installing it.
en.diagExplainText: This page checks for plugins that conflict with each other, mismatched dependencies, or wrong load order. Terms used:
en.diagOkAll: All good: no conflict, dependency or ordering issues found
en.diagTermBundle: bundle = one plugin package, applied in order
en.diagTermEntry: entry = one item a plugin registers in the running composition
en.diagTermOrder: load order = the order plugins activate; the later one may override the earlier
en.diagTermOrphan: invalid entry = config references something that does not exist
en.diagTermPeer: peer dependency = another package a plugin requires from the host
en.diagTermShadow: shadowing = a plugin’s old copy covers the host’s newer one
en.duplicateNames: Same-name plugins (informational only, not a conflict)
en.envFixFail: Automatic setup failed — export the log and attach it to your issue
en.envMissing: pnpm needs to be set up before installing plugins
en.exportedLog: Log exported: dsh-market-log.txt — please attach it to your issue
en.gistErrAuth: GitHub authentication failed: invalid/expired token, or gh CLI not logged in
en.gistErrInvalid: Gist content is invalid or uses an unsupported backup format
en.gistErrNetwork: Cannot reach GitHub — check your network or proxy
en.gistErrNoId: Update mode needs a Gist ID — fill it in, or switch to “Create”
en.gistErrNotFound: Gist not found — check the ID or URL
en.gistErrRateLimit: GitHub rate limit hit, or the token lacks the gist scope
en.gistErrTimeout: GitHub request timed out — check your network and retry
en.gistExportHint: All checked = full backup (config included); unchecking any exports only the selected plugins, with an optional “include config” flag.
en.gistId: Gist ID or URL (leave empty on export to create a new private Gist)
en.gistModeUpdate: Update the Gist in the field
en.gistNoPlugins: This profile has no plugins to export
en.gistNote: Unlike local export (this-machine archive), Gist is for cross-machine sync: export to a private Gist, then import it on another computer with the same account to reuse your plugins. The token lives in this session's memory only and is never written to browser storage; a logged-in gh CLI or DSH_GITHUB_TOKEN skips entering it. Gists are private, 1 MB per file.
en.gistToken: GitHub token (session memory only — re-enter after refresh; leave empty to use server-side DSH_GITHUB_TOKEN or a logged-in gh CLI)
en.groupAddEmpty: Every installed plugin is already in this group
en.hostDependencyWarning: A plugin lists known shared DSH host packages in dependencies. This may shadow the host version; the check is manifest-only and does not confirm a duplicate runtime instance:
en.hotBanner: new plugin(s) ready — refresh the page to use them
en.installedEmpty: No community plugins yet — browse the Discover tab
en.loadFail: Failed to load the plugin catalog, please retry later
en.localOnly: The WebDAV URL and credentials stay in this browser only.
en.marketNoToggle: The market itself cannot be disabled
en.orderAlreadyOptimal: Current order already satisfies every rule and plugin dependency — nothing to reorder
en.orderConflicts: before/after conflicts in the current order
en.orderDiffHint: This order would change the composition: {0} override(s), {1} orphan(s), {2} duplicate(s)
en.orderDragHint: Drag ⠿ to reorder; clicking "Apply order" saves it
en.progressHint: First installs download and resolve dependencies — large plugins can take 1-3 minutes
en.rateCommentPh: Share your experience (optional, up to 500 characters)
en.rateFail: Rating submission failed, please retry later
en.rateOk: Rating submitted, thanks for your feedback
en.ratePickScore: Please pick a star rating first
en.rateTooFast: Too many submissions, please try again later (max 3 per plugin per day)
en.redeemDemo: Try 080808 to unlock a theme for free
en.redeemOk: Unlocked: {0}, added to the list below
en.redeemTitle: Enter a passcode to unlock plugins
en.refreshBanner: change(s) applied — refresh the page to see them
en.reportContactPh: Optional contact so the platform can reach you
en.reportDescPh: Describe the issue and evidence (at least 10 characters)
en.reportFail: Report submission failed, please retry later
en.reportOk: Report submitted. The platform will verify it, usually within 48 hours. Thanks for keeping the marketplace safe.
en.reportRateLimited: Too many submissions, please try again later
en.reportTooShort: Description must be at least 10 characters
en.restartBanner: change(s) done — restart DeepSeek Harness to apply
en.restartHint: To restart: stop the current dsh process and run it again (e.g. dsh web)
en.restartTimeout: Timed out waiting for DeepSeek Harness to start
en.restoreConfirm: Restore will overwrite this profile configuration and reinstall plugins. Continue?
en.restoreMissing: {0} plugins from this backup are not installed
en.restorePartial: Restore continued, but these plugins failed to install:
en.restorePreviewDone: Backup imported. Review Installed, then start restore.
en.setCardDesc: See the version, update, or remove the plugin market.
en.setChannelBetaHint: Early access to unverified versions. Affects the plugin market only.
en.setChannelDevHint: Unverified builds from a development branch. Not recommended for general use.
en.setChannelSwitchHint: This version is lower than the one installed.
en.setSelfConfirm: Remove the plugin market? Installing it again takes the command line.
en.setSelfPurge: Also clear the market's own data
en.setSelfPurgeOff: Keeps the market's data. Note: plugins the market switched off stay off, and once it is removed there is no UI left to switch them back on.
en.setSelfPurgeOn: Will delete: the market's disable list and custom groups, and the disable rows it wrote into the profile patch file — plugins the market switched off start running again. No passwords or tokens are involved; the market never stores those on disk.
en.setSelfRemovedHint: Restart DeepSeek Harness to finish cleaning up.
en.setSelfRemoveHint: Uninstall the market from this profile. Your other plugins are untouched.
en.setSelfUpdatedHint: Downloaded. Restart DeepSeek Harness for it to take effect — the page itself updates at once, the server half does not.
en.setSelfUpdateHint: Updating downloads the new version; it takes effect after a restart.
en.subtitle: Discover dshhub.co and community plugins for DeepSeek Harness
en.terminalWarn: This looks like a terminal/CLI plugin: installing it into the web profile may do nothing, or even break DeepSeek Harness startup. Read its README and install it into the profile it targets.
en.themeEmpty: No more theme plugins in the catalog yet — stay tuned
en.toastTheme: is now active. Switch any time in Settings → Plugin Market → Themes
en.uninstallConfirmDesc: This removes the plugin from the current profile.
en.unlockDeleteConfirm: Remove this unlock record? Installed plugins are not affected.
en.unlockedEmpty: Nothing unlocked yet. Seen a passcode in a creator’s video? Type it in.
en.unlockInstallOk: Installed: {0} — find it in the Installed tab
en.versionHint: Plugin market version — include it when reporting an issue
en.webdavNote: The WebDAV URL and username stay in this browser only; the password is kept server-side and must be re-entered each session.
